contract.intent: Implement uniform --json across all ann commands: a single flag contract (argument + global), every command returns one structured JSON document (help included), JSON errors carry a code and non-zero exit, and no stray text pollutes stdout when JSON is requested.
acceptanceCriteria: A --json argument (and the existing global form) works on EVERY command, help and the derived table included, emitting exactly one JSON document on stdout
Each command has a documented JSON shape (the value the text renders, or a stable envelope when the command has no natural value); errors are {code, blocker} style JSON with non-zero exit
--json is documented in help and the commands table
The full suite is green; e2e asserts well-formed JSON (parseable, expected fields, nothing else on stdout) for a representative set including help
